definition: attraction as a product rather than a sum, where either side can zero the whole thing

settled:
Attraction is a product rather than a sum. Either side can zero the whole of it, so with my safety on the floor there is no attraction however high arousal runs.

Safety multiplies at every level rather than switching at zero, so every step of it is already scaling the product up or down.

It multiplies the safety of the input rather than my background state. That is why a self-generated input still works at minus one, and at minus two there is no arousal term left to multiply.

This does not contradict safety gating arousal. It writes that same fact as arithmetic.

One law feeds two buckets. The regulation deposit fills the same with or without a person, and only the personal kind also deposits into connection. Personal or impersonal decides which bucket fills, rather than the gate or the path.

The law leaves room for movement between arousal, sexual arousal, attraction, connection and the act itself. None of them carries the next with it.
